integrity: The proof reconstructs the complete pairwise compatibility relation among the spine, left, middle, and right page-edge families. That table yields an exhaustive case split and the polynomial without asymptotic or computational assumptions. The maximum-size and maximum-count statements are coefficients of the proved enumerator. The verifier independently tests the original common-edge definition for every subset through six pages.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to square-page book graphs; triangular books, longer-cycle books, and arbitrary generalized theta graphs are not covered.
The edge-open-packing polynomial notation is defined for this result and is not asserted to be standard terminology.
The finite checker exhausts page counts one through six and is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed square-page-book treatment may exist.
title: Edge-open-packing polynomial of square-page book graphs
